integrity: The proof is a direct reconstruction from the source plateau endpoints and address-map recursion. No numerical experiment, unpublished external claim, or independent certification is used.
limitations: Restricted to weak-admissible negative-doubling plateau data in the finite-return classification; the infinite-return case is only the source singleton. The proved numerical invariant is the coordinate separation of the coded plateau boundaries, with endpoint naming at precritical double codings left to the source convention.
title: Exact parity law for negative-doubling survivor-plateau address widths
